correctness.rationale: Alternating site complementation turns exactly the N−1 rate-one reactions into adjacent swaps, and preserves the endpoint pair flip because both endpoints have odd indices. With m even-indexed sites, original even occupation gives K≡m (mod 2), so there are m+1 connected fixed-weight path classes; the endpoint flip connects all successive permitted weights at positive rate. The projected generator B averages endpoint vacancies/occupancies, obtaining b_k=(N−k)(N−k−1)/[N(N−1)] and d_k=k(k−1)/[N(N−1)]. An independent analytic spectrum check triangularizes B on 1,k,…,k^m, a basis by interpolation on the m+1 distinct permitted k's. In B k^j the terms of degree j+1 cancel, and the degree-j coefficient is −4j/N+4j(j−1)/[N(N−1)] = −4j(N−j)/[N(N−1)]. This proves all m+1 distinct eigenvalues including zero without assuming completeness of a parity-restricted polynomial family. The fast block of −L₀ is strictly positive for fixed N; on eliminating it by Schur complement, the small eigenvalue block is −εB plus O_N(ε²). Weyl bounds separate precisely m+1 small eigenvalues from the others, one staying zero. For the slow-time limit, write u=e^{s(L₀/ε+V)}h and Q=I−P; the Q-block is dissipative with fast gap at least g/ε. Variation of constants bounds Qu by e^{−gs/ε}||Qh||+ε||V||||h||/g, so the time-integrated perturbation of Pu from e^{sB}Ph is O_N(ε) on bounded s intervals. For empty start K=m, Bk=−4(k−N/2)/N and the averaged coverage is m/N+k/N², yielding the exact stated expression for each s>0. The isolated uniform K=m shell gives the lower plateau; the positive-rate uniform even-occupation stationary class has marginal 1/2. The fixed-N restriction is essential; no claim at s=0 or of an error uniform in N is made. The frozen CHECK.py is corroboration, not the source of the all-N proof.

value.rationale: Opening the closing bond produces a whole set of conservation-law sectors, not simply a small correction to uniform equilibrium. The result resolves how all the associated zero modes split when that bond is restored and identifies the particular mode observable in empty-start coverage, quantitatively explaining the noncommuting time and defect limits. An exact all-odd-N reduction and full leading slow spectrum are useful beyond just reading off equilibrium coverage or substituting into an auxiliary cube spectrum.
